items.title: NGINX2Root: F5 patches five critical NGINX vulnerabilities
items.summary: F5 has patched five critical vulnerabilities in NGINX, the world’s most widely used open-source web server, that can allow remote code execution under certain conditions. items.title: Google will launch Android app verification requirement globally in January 2027
items.summary: Google announced Android developer verification last year , and despite numerous objections from developers and users, the company is forging ahead .
